dz: 雅各派在苏格兰崛起:警长缪尔之战:大不列颠王国的势力阻止了雅各派的推进,尽管行动没有结果.
de: Jacobite rising in Scotland: Battle of Sheriffmuir: The forces of the Kingdom of Great Britain halt the Jacobite advance, although the action is inconclusive.

dz: 第一次英国内战:特纳姆格林战役:皇家军队面对议会军队而撤退,未能攻取伦敦.
de: First English Civil War: Battle of Turnham Green: The Royalist forces withdraw in the face of the Parliamentarian army and fail to take London.

te: in an English victory over the Scots, Malcolm III of Scotland, and his son Edward, are killed.
dz: 阿尔恩威克战役:在英国战胜苏格兰人,苏格兰的马尔科姆三世和他的儿子爱德华被击毙.
de: Battle of Alnwick: in an English victory over the Scots, Malcolm III of Scotland, and his son Edward, are killed.

dz: 英国国王"瑟勒德二世"下令杀害所有在英国的丹麦人,今天被称为"圣布里斯节大屠杀".
